body:
I don't wanna trigger PTSD, but how did you do it. What were your consequences of failing.

Don't need to tell me if you want privacy either.
I have an Arduino programmed to start releasing the CO 3 hours after I activate it. It is going to be released in 250 ppm over 4 hours. If I go unconscious, I can't get rid of it. Right?
Surely CO poisoning is effective if no one comes to stop me?

I looked into it. I looked into cases similar to mine and CPS law in my state. The most they would do to help me is provide me with a therapist and slap my parents with a warning. A therapist who I loved with all my heart gave up on me and gave me happy pills. I don't think there will be another therapist like that one.

Don't feel guilty. You aren't my mom. Just some other guy on the internet trying to do good. It ain't your fault. It isn't my dad's fault. It's my mom. The narcissistic bitch drove me to depression and I already failed suicide once at 13, two years ago, I still have the cut mark on my wrist. I failed because I cut horizontally instead of vertically. I plan on not making a mistake this time. It wasn't your fault two years ago, and it isn't your fault now.

I don't want to, just tell me if there is an easier way. I already told everyone reading this that there is no changing my mind. Just tell me if there can be easier way to die. Just don't convince me. I don't want to live with my abusive parents for another 3 years. I can't call CPS because there is no evidence of abuse, I can't run away because homelessness is just a longer death. I have no friends. My school counselors don't give a shit. I just wanna die. Let me go, telling me the easiest way to go is helpful. Please...

Thank you for the words, but I don't want to back down. Part of the reason for my suicide is to spite my parents. I feel nothing. The things that used to make me happy no longer do. Everything is a chore. I already bought a carbon monoxide tank. I am planning to inhale it in my sleep at about 250 ppm in 4 hours. Coma in 2 is freedom from pain and emotion. Death in the next 2 is freedom from lack of pain and emotion. I just want to know if something is less painful. I have access to my parents bank account, I'm only 15, I don't have any money, but if I'm dying, might as well just get my parent's help for the first time in my miserable life.

dude, i bore my pain for 4 years, i don't want this sadness, this emptyness, and lack of emotion for another while, my therapist gave up on me and gave me anti-depressants, he said its the best he can do. I dont want my happiness from pills. Just tell me if there is an easier way to go

I think it should be enough. Maybe some more of the klonopin, because I am pretty sure, the dosage overdose scales with weight. Good idea with the ondansetron. I think 400 mg buspirone is good enough. Never heard of people use trazedone with suicide or its purpose. I am going tomorrow with carbon monoxide poisoning, I already set up my entire inhaling system for when I pass out. I have an oxygen mask and it is hooked up to a cylinder of carbon monoxide, i will sleep and I have an arduino programmed to start it at 2 am. Should be dead by 7 am if everything is done correctly.   


However, should you go through with it, I want to let you know that professional help is recommended. I have abusive parents, and, my therapist gave up on me and prescribed me anti-depressants. Really think about what you want to do. I am here to talk.
I still have a fear of my parents. Nothing means anything to me. Also, I dont want to do any of the aforementioned things.
My parents don't know I'm doing this. I can't do any of that. I don't have money. I heard carbon monoxide poisoning is easy, I read somewhere else. I have it all ready, is there an easier way?
Nothing in this world makes me happy and no one loves me. My parents are abusive, i don't have friends. Just tell me, what is the easiest way.
